01-welcome.text: [warmly] Welcome to Zoe's Colleges — one calm, shared place for your family's college search. Everyone gets a voice, every number is real, and nothing gets lost in a group text.

02-sample-family.text: Not ready to set up yet? Explore the sample family first. Tap around, try every feature — nothing you do is saved.

03-set-up-student.text: Start by adding your student. If you're a parent, you can set up their profile now — grades, courses, activities — and it moves to their own account the moment they join.

04-invite-family.text: College is a family decision. Tap Invite to bring in a parent, your student, even a grandparent. They get a one-tap link by email, and everyone sees the same board.

05-today.text: Today is your home base. It shows your one next step, what changed this week, and the deadlines coming up — so you always know what to do next.

06-next-step.text: Not sure where to start? Follow the next-step card. It walks your family from exploring, to visiting, to applying, to deciding — one small step at a time.

07-board.text: Your board holds every school you're considering. Each card shows the three things that matter most: what it will really cost you, your chance of getting in, and how your family rates it.

08-add-schools.text: Add schools by searching any name, nickname, or city. More than three thousand colleges are here, with official federal data behind every number.

09-discover.text: Want fresh ideas? Try Discover. Swipe through schools picked for your student — yes, maybe, or no. [happy] When two of you like the same school, it's a match.

10-zoe-picks.text: Zoe Picks suggests a balanced list — likely schools, targets, and reaches — based on your student's profile and what your family cares about most.

11-chances.text: Every school shows a chance: Likely, Target, Reach, or Far reach. It compares your student's grades, scores, course rigor, and activities with the students that school actually admits. It's a planning

12-match.text: The match percentage is something different. It shows how well a school fits your priorities — cost, size, location, outcomes. A school can be a great match… and still be a reach.

13-priorities.text: Set your priorities with a few simple sliders. Each person in the family sets their own, so you can see where you agree — and where you don't.

14-profile.text: The student profile is built like the Common App: grades, how demanding the schedule is, test scores if you have them, and activities. The more you add, the sharper every chance becomes.

15-transcript.text: Short on time? Snap a photo of the transcript — official or unofficial. Zoe reads the courses and grades, works out the GPA, and counts honors and AP classes for you. You check it before anything is s

16-activities.text: Add up to ten activities, just like the Common App. Sports, jobs, clubs, and family responsibilities all count. Depth matters more than a long list — years and hours tell the real story.

17-costs.text: Costs shows what each school will likely cost your family — not just the sticker price. Add your income once, and every school updates with an estimate built for you.

18-aid-index.text: Colleges expect each family to pay a share, called the Student Aid Index. Zoe estimates yours, then shows which schools give enough aid to bring the price down — and which ones probably won't.

19-merit.text: Merit scholarships reward strong students, whatever your income. When your student's scores are in a school's top quarter, Zoe points it out — those are the students most likely to receive them.

20-aid-offers.text: When acceptance letters arrive, upload the financial aid offer. Zoe reads the numbers, separates real grants from loans, and lines up every offer side by side.

21-deadlines.text: Deadlines keeps every application date in one place, checked against each school's own website. Add them to your Google, Apple, or Outlook calendar with one tap.

22-checklist.text: Under each school is an application checklist — essays, recommendations, the transcript, fees, and financial aid forms. Tick each one as it's done, and your whole family sees the progress.

23-applying-focus.text: Mark the schools you're really applying to. Deadlines then focuses on those, so the page shows exactly what needs doing — and nothing that doesn't.

24-ed-vs-ea.text: Early Decision is binding — if you're admitted, you go. Early Action isn't. Both usually mean applying by early November, and hearing back sooner.

25-plan-visit.text: Plan a campus visit by picking a school and a date. Mark when the tour is booked, change the date anytime, or cancel with two taps.

26-road-trip.text: Visits a few days apart turn into a road trip on their own — with a map, real drive times, and a calendar file you can import.

27-on-campus.text: On visit day, tap "I'm on campus." You'll get a checklist of what to look for, a place for photos, and quick notes — while it's all still fresh.

28-past-visits.text: Already visited a few schools? Add them as past visits — even ones you've ruled out. Give each one stars, and a line to remember it by.

29-talk-it-out.text: Talk It Out gives every school its own calm conversation. Everyone gets a voice, nobody has to win, and the things you agree on are saved.

30-family-vote.text: When it's time to choose, each person ranks their favorites in a secret ballot. Reveal the results together, and see where your family really stands.

31-decision-day.text: Decision Day brings it all together — acceptances, real costs, and everyone's voice — so you can make the big choice with confidence before May first.

32-journey.text: Your Journey tracks the whole adventure — from the first school you add to the final decision. It's the outline of your family's story.

33-memories.text: Save photos from every visit in Memories. Relive them as a reel, or turn them into a short film of your family's college journey.

34-campus-pulse.text: Campus Pulse brings you the latest news, events, and open houses from the schools on your board — so you never miss a visit day.

35-ask-zoe.text: Have a question? Ask Zoe. She knows your student's profile and your list, and she answers in plain English — about essays, aid, deadlines, or which school fits best.

36-college-report.text: The College Report turns everything into one clean PDF — the profile, every school, costs, and deadlines — ready to share with a counselor.

37-privacy.text: Your family's information stays with your family. We never sell it. Transcripts and aid letters are read, then discarded — only the numbers you choose to save are kept.

38-search.text: Looking for something? Tap Search — or press Control K on a computer — and type anything: a school, a page, or a question.

39-outro.text: [warmly] That's Zoe's Colleges. Start with one small step today — and make the biggest decision of the year, together.

40-hi-im-zoe.text: [warmly] Hi! I'm Zoe. Let me show you around — it only takes a minute.
